environment.description: ECS Fargate task running in a private subnet (10.0.1.0/24) with a NAT Gateway attached to the route table, allowing outbound internet access. Security group allows all outbound traffic (0.0.0.0/0). Task IAM role has s3:GetObject and secretsmanager:GetSecretValue permissions. VPC endpoint for ECS metadata is available. No WAF or network ACL restrictions on outbound connections.
